blocks.content:
• Lokpal is NOT constitutional.
• Created in 2013 but first appointed in 2019.
• Covers PM with safeguards.
• Chairperson + max 8 members.
• Has prosecution wing.

items: Common Trap: Lokpal is often mistakenly marked as a constitutional body; it is statutory.
Pay attention to dates: Enacted in 2013, but first appointed in 2019.
Jurisdiction nuance: The Prime Minister IS covered, but with specific safeguards.
Composition structure: Chairperson + a maximum of 8 members.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lokpal is a statutory body, not a constitutional one.
The legislation was enacted in 2013, but the first appointment was made in 2019.
The jurisdiction extends to the Prime Minister with predefined safeguards.
Composition consists of a Chairperson plus a maximum of 8 members.
It is equipped with its own dedicated prosecution wing.
